title: Strong or weak prompt?
instruction: Which prompt gets a good result out of AI? Sort the requests!

items.why: What exactly, for whom and how long? The AI has to guess.

items.text: “Explain black holes to an eighth-grader in 5 bullet points with an example”
items.why: The topic, the reader, the length and the form are all clear.
The topic, the length and who it's for are all missing.

items.text: “Summarise this text in 3 sentences for a classmate, in English”
items.why: The task, the length, the reader and the language are all given.
With what exactly? The AI doesn't know where to start.

items.text: “Test me with 5 questions on fractions, one at a time, explaining my mistakes”
items.why: It says exactly what the AI should do and how.

items.text: “Correct the spelling in the text and mark the changes in bold”
items.why: A clear task and a clear form for the result.
What does better mean? Shorter, funnier, without mistakes?

debrief: A strong prompt says exactly what you want, for whom, in what form and how long. A weak prompt leaves the AI guessing, and then it gives a general answer.
